def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(v for v in range(1, 10)
               if any(all(row[c] == v for row in grid) for c in range(w)))
    hr = [r for r in range(h) if all(x == sep for x in grid[r])]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    rb = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + vc + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Complete horizontal mirror pairs of panels. A pair is indicated by
    # another panel in the same column having content on both sides.
    for k, rsep in enumerate(hr):
        a0, a1 = rb[k] + 1, rsep
        b0, b1 = rsep + 1, rb[k + 2]
        if a1 - a0 != b1 - b0:
            continue
        for j in range(len(cb) - 1):
            c0, c1 = cb[j] + 1, cb[j + 1]
            a = [grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(a0, a1)]
            b = [grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(b0, b1)]
            if any(x for row in a for x in row) and not any(x for row in b for x in row):
                # Only fill if this divider has a corresponding populated
                # panel pair elsewhere in the same color arrangement.
                color = next(x for row in a for x in row if x)
                paired = False
                for jj in range(len(cb) - 1):
                    if jj == j:
                        continue
                    x0, x1 = cb[jj] + 1, cb[jj + 1]
                    if (any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(a0, a1) for c in range(x0, x1)) and
                        any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(b0, b1) for c in range(x0, x1))):
                        paired = True
                        break
                if paired:
                    for d in range(b1 - b0):
                        out[b0+d][c0:c1] = a[-1-d][:]
            elif any(x for row in b for x in row) and not any(x for row in a for x in row):
                color = next(x for row in b for x in row if x)
                paired = False
                for jj in range(len(cb) - 1):
                    if jj == j:
                        continue
                    x0, x1 = cb[jj] + 1, cb[jj + 1]
                    if (any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(a0, a1) for c in range(x0, x1)) and
                        any(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(b0, b1) for c in range(x0, x1))):
                        paired = True
                        break
                if paired:
                    for d in range(a1 - a0):
                        out[a0+d][c0:c1] = b[-1-d][:]
    return out
